title: Cast Iron vs. PVC: DWV Material Selection
description: Choosing the correct material for Drain-Waste-Vent (DWV) piping depends on building acoustical needs, structural height, and fire safety codes. PVC pipe is lightweight, affordable, and immune to chemical corrosion, making it the standard choice for most residential installations. However, cast iron drainage piping provides exceptional sound dampening, reducing the noise of flowing wastewater inside living spaces, while offering high fire resistance for commercial and multi-family structures. Knowing when to specify cast iron over plastic helps plumbers deliver quiet, durable, and code-compliant DWV systems tailored to project requirements.

Cast Iron vs. PVC: DWV Material Selection

Choosing the correct material for Drain-Waste-Vent (DWV) piping depends on building acoustical needs, structural height, and fire safety codes. PVC pipe is lightweight, affordable, and immune to chemical corrosion, making it the standard choice for most residential installations. However, cast iron drainage piping provides exceptional sound dampening, reducing the noise of flowing wastewater inside living spaces, while offering high fire resistance for commercial and multi-family structures. Knowing when to specify cast iron over plastic helps plumbers deliver quiet, durable, and code-compliant DWV systems tailored to project requirements.
